title: Online bookseller review ratings, one-star effects, and review length
statement:
For online booksellers, improvements in consumer review ratings were associated with increased relative sales, one-star reviews often had a stronger effect than five-star reviews, and review-length evidence suggested shoppers read review text rather than relying only on summary statistics. (Sage Journals)
